description: Search the UMD campus directory by separate name parts, email, work phone, department, affiliation and institution. At least one of the name, email or phone fields is required; department only narrows another field. No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates; students are only included after login.

affiliations.description: Affiliations to include (default: faculty, staff and affiliate, plus student when signed in)

department.description: Department name to narrow by, e.g. "Computer Science"

items.description: Institution code: "UMCP" University of Maryland, College Park, "USMO" University System of Maryland Office, "UMES" University of Maryland Eastern Shore, "UMCES" University of Maryland Center for Environmental Science

phone.description: Work phone, digits or dashed, e.g. "301-405-5803"

name: directory_search_advanced

limit_reached.description: true when the directory capped the results (50 anonymously, 100 signed in); narrow the search to see the rest

message.description: Notice the directory showed instead of results, e.g. "No users found"; null otherwise

people.description: Matching people in the order the directory lists them

address.description: Office address lines (building, street, city); empty if not published

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID (local part of a @umd.edu email); null for other institutions

email.description: Email address; null if not published

name.description: Full name as listed, e.g. "Darryll J Pines"

phone.description: Work phone, e.g. "+1 301 405 5803"; null if none

title.description: Job title, e.g. "Research Scientist"; null if none

title: Advanced directory search
